draftFindings.observation: Queue held only a 3-line test stub; a complete module was implemented.
Parent browser: flat water/banks and box raft; key-less opening prompt. Fixed with foam, ripples, eddy spirals, layered shores, paddler and wake; prompts name keys.
End walls had outward normals so the raft escaped the river and soft-locked; fixed and regression-tested at 250-5000 px/s.
Raft could sit off-screen at the upstream end; wall moved to x=0 with a drawn start log.
Text-only players with 0.4-0.8 s lag won 13-20/40 in section 3. Eddies/cross-currents softened, gates widened, damage threshold 100 px/s; 0.4-0.6 s lag now wins 40/40 per rate.
Parent browser: prompts changed every 0.3-0.5 s. Now held about 0.6 s except dock/damage events, with a test.

finalReview.evidence: 35/35 tests. Invalid time inert; identical state at 30/60/120 Hz; 152,527 random fast collisions without tunnelling or speed gain; 897k random steps without NaN or rock overlap; walls hold at x=12 and 1788; forces compose additively with no hidden thrust; flags once, dock needs a stop, loss fires once and freezes. Text-only policy: 40/40 at 0-0.6 s lag per rate, 27-33/40 at 0.4-0.8 s.
finalReview.limitations: About 5-6% of prompt changes are shorter than 0.55 s (dock/damage exemptions and section starts).

draftFindings.observation: Queue held only a 3-line test stub; a complete module was implemented.
Parent browser: clipped lives icons, no visible lift, missing helmet lamps/collapse dust, banner overlap. Fixed.
X woke a miner while the prompt said brace; bracing now takes priority inside a cracking span.
Beam prompt shown where a beam could not prevent the crack; now says the ceiling will crack.
Dig prompts alternated every 0.25-0.3 s; now held.
Cracks-nearby prompt hid low air; low air now outranks it outside the span.
Added a fresh-air refill hint at the surface.
Beams-restocked message overwrote the loss reason; loss message now holds.
Parent: event messages never reached getState().status (screen-reader text); now included before the prompt in both languages.

finalReview.evidence: 39/39 tests; 100% line, 98.03% branch coverage. Invalid time inert; identical state at 30/60/120 Hz; collapse warning 3.84 s precedes damage at exactly the displayed time; rubble re-diggable, rock not; miners move orthogonally on open tiles, wake only adjacent, board only on the lift, score once; oxygen invariants held over 24 monitored bot runs; reviewer prompt-and-tiles policy won 144/144 across 0.15-0.6 s lag and 30/60/120 Hz without losing a life; about 37 test mutants written.
finalReview.limitations: A collapse can cut a player off; the only loss path is running out of air, which is explained. Module is about 1100 lines.

finalReview.evidence: 44/44 tests, 100% line coverage. Invalid time inert; identical state at 30/60/120 Hz; 6000-path shield sweep matches an exact plate oracle with no tunnelling; reviewer bot seeing only prompts, telegraphs and shots wins 20/20 at 0.15-0.35 s lag and 16-18/20 at 0.4-0.6 s.
